fa_compensation.player_selected.title: {selected_player_link} moves as FA compensation pick
fa_compensation.player_selected.body:
The compensation process tied to {fa_player_link}'s free-agent move is complete. {original_team_link} selected {selected_player_link} from outside {signing_team_link}'s protected list under Grade {grade} compensation rules.

The package is {cash_text} and one eligible player. For the signing club, the free-agent deal now carries its final cost. For the original club, a departure turns into a new roster asset.

fa_compensation.player_selected.body.v2:
{original_team_link} has filed its FA compensation choice. After {fa_player_link}'s Grade {grade} move to {signing_team_link}, the club took {selected_player_link} from the eligible pool.

The KBO record pairs {cash_text} with the player selection. One club got the free agent, and the other received the result of the protected-list process.
fa_compensation.obligation.title: {fa_player_link} move opens FA compensation process
fa_compensation.obligation.body:
{fa_player_link}'s move to {signing_team_link} has opened a compensation case for {original_team_link}. Under Grade {grade} rules, the return is {cash_with_player_text} plus one player from outside the protected list, or {cash_only_text} in cash.

{signing_team_link} must submit a {protect_count}-player protected list within {protected_list_due_days} days. Once that list is in, {original_team_link} will decide whether to take a player or settle the case as cash compensation.

The first deadline belongs to {signing_team_link}: a {protect_count}-player protected list is due within {protected_list_due_days} days. The original club's choice follows after that filing.
fa_compensation.protected_list_submitted:

{original_team_link} now has {selection_due_days} days to choose a player from outside the list or take {cash_only_text} in cash compensation. The final decision will close the case through either a player move or a cash payment.

fa_compensation.cash_only.title: {fa_player_link} compensation closes as cash
fa_compensation.cash_only.body:
The compensation tied to {fa_player_link}'s free-agent move has been set as cash. {original_team_link} will receive {cash_text} from {signing_team_link} under Grade {grade} rules.

No compensation player changes clubs in this case. {original_team_link} gains spending room for its next roster move, while {signing_team_link} closes the FA cost in cash.

fa_compensation.cash_required.body:
{fa_player_link}'s free-agent compensation has been set as cash. Under Grade {grade} rules, this case creates a cash payment without a compensation-player selection.

{original_team_link} will receive {cash_text} from {signing_team_link}. No protected-list or player-selection process opens for this grade.
